'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 2 Brian Herold DS Death Star''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star|ANH-D-deathstar.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' MPC CPI AKA MC PIMP
* '''Username:''' The Smoking Gungan
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
